definitions.explanation: A state of economic success, growth, or thriving. Can apply to businesses, families, nations, or communities.

examples.japanese: {子孫|しそん}{繁栄|はんえい}を{願|ねが}う。
examples.english: To wish for the prosperity of one's descendants.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}は{繁栄|はんえい}している。
{経済|けいざい}の{繁栄|はんえい}が{続|つづ}いた。

notes:
USAGE: Used in formal contexts to describe prosperity of nations, businesses, or family lines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{繁栄|はんえい}する (to prosper/flourish)
・{経済|けいざい}{繁栄|はんえい} (economic prosperity)
・{子孫|しそん}{繁栄|はんえい} (prosperity of descendants)
・{繁栄|はんえい}を{極|きわ}める (to reach the height of prosperity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{発展|はってん} (development; progress)
・{栄|さか}える (to prosper - verb)
